description: This file defines the AppDbContext class for Entity Framework Core, which configures database access and entity relationships for the NotesAppBackend application.

classes.name: AppDbContext
classes.description: Entity Framework Core database context for notes application, manages DbSets for User and Note entities and configures model relationships.

methods.description: Constructor that accepts DbContextOptions to configure the context.

methods.description: Overrides EF Core method to configure entity properties, indexes, and relationships.
